bottleneck.description: OTC Daihen is a leading arc-welding robot brand with strong Japanese auto OEM footprint; competes with Yaskawa, Panasonic, Fanuc, Nachi, Kuka in welding cells.

dependency.key_customers: Japanese auto OEMs, transformer/grid customers, semiconductor (RF generators)

editorial.notes: Daihen's OTC welding robot franchise claims global leadership in arc-welding robots, but the segment is highly contested by Yaskawa Motoman, Panasonic, Fanuc and ABB. Welding cell procurement is competitive. Daihen also makes semiconductor RF generators where AEIS dominates -- it is not the marginal supplier. No bottleneck.
